mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_feedback (invite_uuid, survey_id, email, create_time) VALUES (#{inviteUuid}, #{surveyId}, #{email}, NOW())

INSERT INTO survey_feedback_question (feedback_id, question_id, question_type, question_content, answer_content, create_time) VALUES (#{feedbackId}, #{questionId}, #{questionType}, #{questionContent}, #{answerContent}, NOW())
INSERT INTO survey_feedback_option (feedback_question_id, option_id, option_content, create_time) VALUES (#{feedbackQuestionId}, #{optionId}, #{optionContent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, invite_uuid AS inviteUuid, survey_id AS surveyId, email, create_time AS createTime FROM survey_feedback WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, feedback_id AS feedbackId, question_id AS questionId, question_type AS questionType, question_content AS questionContent, answer_content AS answerContent, create_time AS createTime FROM survey_feedback_question WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, feedback_question_id AS feedbackQuestionId, option_id AS optionId, option_content AS optionContent, create_time AS createTime FROM survey_feedback_option WHERE feedback_question_id = #{feedbackQuestionId} ORDER BY id
